title: Rees equivalence of Ext vanishing and existence of a regular sequence
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subset R$ an ideal and $M\neq0$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] such that $IM\neq M$. For each integer $n\ge0$, the following are equivalent: (1) $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(R/I,M)=0$ [def-pc-ext] for every $0\le i<n$; (2) there is an $M$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] of length $n$ all of whose terms lie in $I$.
